definition: Air temperature in the layer that heats intertidal organisms and farm workers during emersion (typically 1.5–2 m screen height or a documented intertidal microclimate). This is an atmospheric quantity, not sea-surface temperature. For Willapa/WA oyster 72 h ops-risk it is a causal heat/desiccation driver when paired with emersion.
biological_relevance: Lethal and sublethal aerial heat during low tide; 2021 NE Pacific heat dome coincident with midday minus tides caused mass intertidal oyster mortality (Raymond et al. 2022 Ecology).
taxonomic_relevance: High for intertidal cultured bivalves (Magallana gigas); relevant to other emersed invertebrates and some intertidal algae; weak for fully subtidal taxa at 72 h.
spatial_scale: lease_to_estuary; airport/buoy point plus UNKNOWN microclimate offset
depth_relevance: air; INTERTIDAL_AIR when emersed; not a water-column variable
preferred_measurement_methods: Calibrated NWS/ASOS, CO-OPS/NDBC air-temperature sensors, farm-mounted shaded thermistors at bag height
valid_proxy_methods: Nearest official met station with documented fetch/elevation bias; NWS forecast air T. Satellite land-surface temperature is not a default proxy (UNKNOWN bias over water/mudflat).
required_metadata: sensor_height_m; radiation_shield; station_id; time_zone; as_of; whether measurement is on-lease vs off-lease
uncertainty_method: Instrument spec plus station-to-lease representativeness (qualitative until collocation). Do not invent ±degC. Pair missingness with EMIV-QUA-FRESH-001.
update_expectation: hourly observations; hourly-to-3h forecast through 72 h
source_standards: Superset of GOOS EOVs (air T is a GCOS atmospheric ECV, not an ocean EOV). IOOS core: Temperature (atmospheric complement). https://gcos.wmo.int/en/essential-climate-variables ; https://goosocean.org/what-we-do/framework/essential-ocean-variables/
minimum_quality_threshold: Provider quality flag pass; known station; timestamp usable at issuance. Reject unshielded solar-loaded sensors for lethal-heat claims. Numeric RMSE UNKNOWN until Willapa collocation.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC; environmental field after licence; fusion with farm IDs inherits PRIVATE

definition: In-water temperature of the surface mixed layer or shallow lease water (bulk, not satellite skin). Raises metabolism, modulates DO solubility, and is a summer-mortality co-factor for Pacific oyster. Distinct from EMIV-PHY-SST-001 (skin/foundation satellite SST) and from aerial heat.
biological_relevance: Causal co-stressor for sessile cultured bivalves; habitat covariate for many ectotherms. NANOOS grower guidance flags prolonged water >64 F; spawning often >18–20 C (literature envelopes; site-specific).
taxonomic_relevance: Broad; W1 focus Magallana gigas adults/juveniles on leases. Not a fish-count variable.
spatial_scale: sub_basin_to_lease; in situ point with UNKNOWN interpolation to ungaged leases
depth_relevance: typically 0–5 m or intake/cage depth; must state sensor depth
preferred_measurement_methods: CTD/thermistor chains, NERRS/NANOOS/ORCA/Ecology moorings, farm loggers at culture depth
valid_proxy_methods: Well-mixed unstratified shallow water: satellite SST (EMIV-PHY-SST-001) with documented skin-bulk and land-contamination mismatch. Never a proxy for emersion air heat or for stratified DO. Regional OFS (WCOFS/LiveOcean) only if licensed and skill-stated for that estuary.
required_metadata: sensor_depth_m; instrument; QC flags; as_of; whether stratified; waterbody_id
uncertainty_method: QARTOD T/S flags plus representativeness. Model-analysis spread is not in situ error. UNKNOWN local RMSE until collocation.
update_expectation: minutes_to_hourly in situ where a station exists; otherwise daily satellite/model proxy with mismatch flag
source_standards: GOOS EOV Sea Surface Temperature / Subsurface Temperature (near-surface bulk). IOOS core: Temperature. GHRSST is the satellite standard but is the proxy path. https://goosocean.org/what-we-do/framework/essential-ocean-variables/
minimum_quality_threshold: QARTOD/provider pass; depth known. Do not impute from SST in stratified basins. Hood Canal ORCA is not Willapa truth.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC; environmental field after licence

definition: Temperature as a function of depth (profile or discrete habitat bins). Required to place thermal habitat volume (e.g. adult Chinook ~8–12 C band) and to detect stratification that SST cannot see. Claim is a physical profile, not animal presence.
biological_relevance: Vertical placement of thermal habitat; hypoxia often co-located with stratification. SST-only products can invert the biological signal when animals go deeper as the surface warms.
taxonomic_relevance: High for pelagic fishes and diving taxa; moderate for subtidal benthos; low for intertidal emersion mortality.
spatial_scale: station_to_shelf; glider sections; model grid (skill UNKNOWN locally)
temporal_scale: hours_to_days for profiles; seasonal for climatology
depth_relevance: full water column; bins required (e.g. SURFACE_0_5, THERMOCLINE, BOTTOM)
preferred_measurement_methods: CTD, Argo, gliders, thermistor chains, animal-borne CTD (AniBOS) with tag-bias stated
valid_proxy_methods: Assimilative 3D ocean analyses (CMEMS PHY, WCOFS, GoMOFS) as MODEL-INFERRED profiles, never as observations. Climatology if labeled climatology.
required_metadata: depth_coordinate; vertical_datum; profile_QC; as_of; model_vs_observed flag
uncertainty_method: Profile QC; for models use published QUID/skill and withhold numeric FishAI RMSE (UNKNOWN).
update_expectation: hours_to_days where platforms exist; otherwise sparse/UNKNOWN
source_standards: GOOS EOV Subsurface Temperature. IOOS core: Temperature. Argo. https://argo.ucsd.edu/about/status/
minimum_quality_threshold: Depth coordinate present; QC pass. Reject surface-only SST as a profile.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC for physics; animal-borne profiles inherit telemetry tier (often NEVER_PUBLISH at native track)

definition: In-water temperature at or near the seafloor / trap / cage bottom. Distinct from SST. ASMFC 2025 lobster peer review: satellite SST is a poor substitute for bottom T in a stratified Gulf of Maine.
biological_relevance: Catchability, molt phenology, and stress for benthic crustaceans; subtidal shellfish metabolism. Not 72 h intertidal oyster aerial kill.
taxonomic_relevance: High for Homarus americanus and other benthos; low for W1 intertidal emersion pathway.
depth_relevance: seafloor / gear depth; must record depth_m
preferred_measurement_methods: Bottom landers, eMOLT/CFRF trap loggers, near-bottom mooring sensors
valid_proxy_methods: 3D OFS bottomT with published shelf skill; climatology. Satellite SST is not a valid default proxy in stratified seasons.
required_metadata: instrument_height_above_bottom_m; depth_m; QC; as_of; gear_type if trap-mounted
uncertainty_method: Logger spec plus spatial representativeness. UNKNOWN interpolation error between traps.
source_standards: GOOS EOV Subsurface Temperature (near-bottom). IOOS core: Temperature. eMOLT https://www.emolt.org/
minimum_quality_threshold: Bottom depth known; QC pass. Reject SST-as-bottom-T for stratified GOM.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC for physics; trap GPS PRIVATE/NEVER_PUBLISH (bin to statistical area for any public derivative)

definition: Remotely sensed sea-surface temperature: skin (IR, micrometres) or foundation/bulk analysis (e.g. GHRSST L4 MUR). Measures the optical/microwave surface, not aerial intertidal heat, not bottom T, not fish. Valid physical EMIV. Invalid as abundance, harvest legality, or (alone) W1 oyster ops-risk.
biological_relevance: Thermal habitat covariate and heatwave index for pelagic surface waters; weak/wrong for intertidal emersion mortality and for stratified bottom-dwelling taxa.
taxonomic_relevance: Surface-associated taxa as habitat covariate only. Never taxon-specific abundance.
spatial_scale: km_pixel to global L4 grid (MUR 0.01 deg; many L4 0.05–0.25 deg)
temporal_scale: sub-daily geo to daily L4; composites must not leak future into as-of replay
depth_relevance: skin_micrometres to foundation ~1–5 m; not the water column
preferred_measurement_methods: GHRSST L2/L3/L4 with quality_level; CoastWatch/Copernicus SST with product ID
valid_proxy_methods: None needed — this IS the satellite SST variable. It is itself a proxy for EMIV-PHY-WTEMP-001 only under well-mixed shallow conditions.
required_metadata: product_id; skin_vs_foundation; quality_level; L4_analysis_vs_L3; as_of; cloud/land mask
uncertainty_method: GHRSST SSES/analysis error fields if provided; otherwise qualitative. Do not treat analysis error as FishAI decision RMSE (UNKNOWN).
update_expectation: daily NRT typical; delayed science-quality later — never mix without as_of
source_standards: GOOS EOV Sea Surface Temperature. IOOS core: Temperature. GHRSST. Copernicus SST products. https://goosocean.org/what-we-do/framework/essential-ocean-variables/
minimum_quality_threshold: GHRSST quality_level usable (typically >=3 where that scale applies) or provider equivalent; land/cloud masked. Insufficient alone for W1 ops-risk.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC after licence; fusion with biology inherits biological tier

definition: Practical salinity of seawater (PSS-78 / TEOS-10 derived practical salinity as documented). Estuarine freshwater pulses plus co-delivered TSS/contaminants drive flood mortalities in Pacific oyster; species is euryhaline but acute lows are stressful.
biological_relevance: Osmotic stress; flood-mortality co-factor; plume structure for coastal fishes. Not a 72 h abundance map.
taxonomic_relevance: High for estuarine bivalves; variable for marine stenohaline taxa.
spatial_scale: estuary_to_shelf; in situ point vs coarse model
depth_relevance: surface and depth-resolved; state sensor depth
preferred_measurement_methods: CTD conductivity, NERRS/NANOOS/ORCA salinity, calibrated farm sondes
valid_proxy_methods: USGS river discharge + rain as upstream pulse proxy (EMIV-BGC-RUNOFF-001); 3D OFS salinity with estuary-skill caveat (global 1/12 deg is coarse for Willapa/Puget).
required_metadata: practical_vs_absolute; sensor_depth_m; QC; as_of; nearby_discharge_ids if proxy
uncertainty_method: QARTOD T/S; conductivity drift/biofouling. UNKNOWN lease-scale RMSE.
update_expectation: hourly in situ where present; event-scale during named rain
source_standards: GOOS EOV Sea Surface Salinity / Subsurface Salinity. IOOS core: Salinity. TEOS-10. https://ioos.noaa.gov/about/ioos-by-the-numbers/
minimum_quality_threshold: QC pass; unit convention documented. Do not treat global CMEMS so as Willapa creek salinity.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC after licence

definition: Horizontal velocity of the near-surface ocean. Transports water, eDNA, larvae, heat, and pollutants. HF radar and drifters observe currents, not animals.
biological_relevance: Larval/eDNA/plume transport; residence-time context for growth (seasonal). Weak as a 72 h oyster mortality nowcast by itself.
taxonomic_relevance: Broad transport context; not taxon abundance.
spatial_scale: HF radar 0.5–6 km coastal; global models ~1/12 deg
depth_relevance: surface (typically 0–1 m; HF radar effective depth depends on frequency)
preferred_measurement_methods: HF radar (IOOS DAC), ADCPs (near-surface bin), drifters
valid_proxy_methods: OFS/CMEMS surface u,v with QUID; tidal-current predictions near gauges
uncertainty_method: Provider error fields if any; otherwise UNKNOWN. Geometric GDOP for HF radar.
source_standards: GOOS EOV Surface Currents. IOOS core: Currents. https://goosocean.org/what-we-do/framework/essential-ocean-variables/
minimum_quality_threshold: Coverage mask; do not interpolate across radar gaps as truth. Not navigation.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC after licence; not a vessel-tracking product

definition: Horizontal (and documented vertical) velocity below the surface bin. ADCP/model profiles. Not fish.
biological_relevance: Subsurface transport; weak for W1 72 h farm ops.
taxonomic_relevance: Context for pelagic/larval stages; not abundance.
preferred_measurement_methods: ADCP, current meters, glider-derived
valid_proxy_methods: 3D OFS/CMEMS currents with QUID
uncertainty_method: ADCP QC; model QUID; FishAI RMSE UNKNOWN
source_standards: GOOS EOV Subsurface Currents. IOOS core: Currents.
minimum_quality_threshold: Depth bins present; QC pass
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC after licence

definition: Surface-wave field (significant wave height, peak period, direction as available). For W1: gear loss, burial, stranding, and inability to work tides — operational disruption, not oyster physiology. For charters/lobster: go/no-go and catchability. Not navigation safety certification.
biological_relevance: Physical disturbance of gear and intertidal beds; realized effort. Not abundance.
spatial_scale: estuary_to_coast; local fetch often unresolved by global wave models
preferred_measurement_methods: NDBC/CDIP wave buoys; NWS marine; GFS-Wave; farm damage logs as outcome not as wave sensor
valid_proxy_methods: Copernicus WAV / NOAA GFS-Wave with fetch caveat; wind-only as incomplete proxy (EMIV-PHY-WIND-001)
required_metadata: parameter (Hs vs swell vs wind-sea); product_id; as_of; not_for_navigation flag
uncertainty_method: Buoy spec; model QUID. Estuary skill UNKNOWN unless local buoy.
source_standards: GOOS EOV Sea State. IOOS core: Surface waves. https://ioos.noaa.gov/about/ioos-by-the-numbers/
minimum_quality_threshold: QC pass on buoys; models labeled MODEL-INFERRED. Do not serve as navigation.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC after licence

definition: Near-surface wind (typically 10 m equivalent). Drives waves, setup, mixing, and whether crews can work. Complementary to waves; not a fish map.
biological_relevance: Workability, wave generation, mixing/DO ventilation, evaporative cooling/heating. Realized CPUE confounder for vessel fisheries.
taxonomic_relevance: Operational for farms and vessels; indirect for wild taxa.
preferred_measurement_methods: NDBC/ASOS/CO-OPS anemometers; NWS forecast grids
valid_proxy_methods: Scatterometer/model 10 m winds with stability/height adjustment documented
uncertainty_method: WMO/NWS station practice; local gustiness UNKNOWN
source_standards: IOOS core: Wind speed and direction. GCOS atmospheric ECV. Not a GOOS ocean EOV (superset).
minimum_quality_threshold: Height known or standard 10 m equivalent stated; QC pass
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC after licence

variable_name: Tide stage / astronomical and observed water level
definition: Water level relative to a documented tidal datum (predictions and/or observations). Controls intertidal emersion, flooding, and some residual currents. Official CO-OPS predictions are the preferred astronomical component in WA waters.
unit: m relative to named datum (MLLW/NAVD88 as documented)
biological_relevance: Modulator of aerial heat and DO flushing; work-window for intertidal farms.
taxonomic_relevance: Intertidal and estuarine taxa; minor for offshore troll relative to wind.
spatial_scale: site_to_estuary; station plus UNKNOWN spatial offset in complex bays
temporal_scale: hourly (minutes at gauges); 18.6-y nodal context not needed for 72 h
depth_relevance: water-level; converts to emersion via lease elevation
preferred_measurement_methods: NOAA CO-OPS water level and harmonic predictions; GLOSS gauges
valid_proxy_methods: Regional tidal models; constituent-based predictions at subordinate stations with published offsets
required_metadata: datum; station_id; predicted_vs_observed; time_zone (source-local for tides); as_of
uncertainty_method: CO-OPS published prediction residuals where available; otherwise UNKNOWN offset to lease.
update_expectation: 6-min observed where gauged; high/low and hourly predictions routinely
source_standards: GOOS EOV Sea Surface Height (coastal water level). IOOS core: Sea level. CO-OPS https://tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/
minimum_quality_threshold: Datum named; station identified. Moon phase is not a substitute (EMIV rejected as independent 72 h driver).
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC

definition: Derived physical state: hours and clock-time that a named culture elevation is out of water. Causal exposure window for aerial heat/desiccation. Not a biodiversity count. Not tide-table cosmetics.
biological_relevance: First-order control on whether air-temperature stress is realized. Heat dome + midday minus tides = W1 lethal pathway.
taxonomic_relevance: Intertidal culture (bottom, bag, rack); near-zero for continuously subtidal rafts (then water T/DO dominate).
preferred_measurement_methods: Tide time series + surveyed or operator-stated culture elevation; optional on-bag wet/dry sensors
valid_proxy_methods: Nearest CO-OPS station + operator tidal-elevation class if survey GPS unavailable (bias UNKNOWN)
uncertainty_method: Elevation error dominates. Do not invent minute-precision without a survey.
update_expectation: recompute with each tide cycle / forecast issuance
source_standards: Superset: derived from GOOS/IOOS sea level + operator elevation. No standalone EOV. Crosswalk: Sea level EOV + aquaculture metadata.
minimum_quality_threshold: Elevation class known (at least intertidal vs subtidal). Without it, air-heat pathway is unidentified.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: COARSENED/PRIVATE; exact bag GPS and lease corners NEVER_PUBLISH publicly

definition: Incoming shortwave irradiance and/or solar geometry at the culture surface during emersion (midday sun). Atmospheric/radiative driver of tissue and bag heating when paired with air temperature and emersion. Not chlorophyll (EMIV-BGC-CHL-001), not underwater PAR/Kd (EMIV-PHY-LIGHT-001), not SST.
unit: W m-2 (irradiance); solar elevation/zenith or daytime-emersion flag as documented
biological_relevance: First-order heating term in the 2021 heat-dome path: air x midday emersion x solar. Morning vs afternoon lows change realized tissue heat at the same air T. Not a pigment or bloom index.
taxonomic_relevance: High for intertidal cultured bivalves (Magallana gigas) and other emersed invertebrates; near-zero for continuously subtidal culture; not a fish-count variable.
spatial_scale: lease_to_estuary; geometry is pointwise from time+lat; irradiance may be airport/grid with UNKNOWN microclimate offset
temporal_scale: minutes_to_hourly; 72 h integrals of daytime emersion coincidence
depth_relevance: air / INTERTIDAL_AIR when emersed; not an in-water optical depth
preferred_measurement_methods: Pyranometer or farm-mounted shortwave sensor; solar geometry from timestamp + latitude + documented timezone coincident with emersion (zenith/elevation or daytime-emersion flag). NWS/NREL clear-sky or observed insolation with as_of.
valid_proxy_methods: Clear-sky insolation x geometry when clouds are UNKNOWN; satellite incoming shortwave with cloud mask. Chlorophyll and ocean-color PAR are not valid proxies for emersion heating. SST is not insolation.
required_metadata: method (measured_irradiance vs geometry_flag); time_zone; coincident_with_emersion; as_of; station_or_grid_id
uncertainty_method: Geometry from time/lat is well posed; cloud/irradiance RMSE UNKNOWN until collocation. Do not invent W m-2 skill.
update_expectation: hourly observations or geometry through 72 h forecast
source_standards: Superset of GOOS ocean EOVs (incoming solar is a GCOS atmospheric ECV — Surface radiation budget / incoming shortwave — not an ocean EOV). Distinct from GOOS Ocean Colour and IOOS Optical properties (those are EMIV-PHY-LIGHT-001). Not chlorophyll. https://gcos.wmo.int/en/essential-climate-variables
minimum_quality_threshold: Timestamp and location sufficient for geometry; measured series need a radiation sensor ID. Reject chlorophyll-as-solar and SST-as-solar.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC; environmental field after licence; fusion with farm IDs inherits PRIVATE

definition: Temperature of the organism, a biomimetic logger, or culture gear (bag/bed thermistor) — the thermal state that air x emersion x solar act on. Distinct from EMIV-PHY-SST-001 (satellite skin/foundation proxy), EMIV-PHY-WTEMP-001 (bulk water), and EMIV-PHY-ATEMP-001 (screen-height or shaded air). W1_CORE when a partner sensor exists; otherwise CANDIDATE with high decision value.
biological_relevance: Direct heat-budget state during emersion; lethal/sublethal tissue T. SST can be near-normal while this quantity is lethal. Not abundance.
taxonomic_relevance: High for intertidal cultured bivalves (Magallana gigas) and other emersed invertebrates; low for fully subtidal taxa at 72 h; not a fish-count variable.
spatial_scale: bag_or_bed / lease; UNKNOWN interpolation between uninstrumented bags
temporal_scale: minutes_to_hourly; event windows plus ongoing if already logging
depth_relevance: INTERTIDAL_AIR when emersed; sensor placement (tissue vs bag vs mud vs shaded air) must be named
preferred_measurement_methods: On-bag or on-bed thermistors already on gear (HOBO/Onset/farm sonde); biomimetic loggers; tissue probes under DUA. Record sun vs shade.
valid_proxy_methods: None as a default. Screen-height air T is not tissue T. Satellite SST (EMIV-PHY-SST-001) is not a valid proxy during emersion. Manual shade-vs-sun max/min notes are qualitative only.
required_metadata: placement (tissue vs bag vs mud vs shaded_air); sun_vs_shade; culture_method; lease_id (PRIVATE); instrument; as_of
uncertainty_method: Placement error dominates. UNKNOWN bag-to-bag interpolation. Do not treat SST analysis error as tissue RMSE.
update_expectation: as logged where devices exist; UNKNOWN / do not impute from SST if none
source_standards: Superset: no GOOS EOV or GEO BON EBV for organism or culture-gear temperature. Intertidal heat-budget / biomimetic-logger literature (Helmuth-class). Not GHRSST and not IOOS water Temperature. Do not map MUR/CoastWatch SST to this ID.
minimum_quality_threshold: Placement documented. Reject SST-as-tissue-T and air-T-as-tissue-T for lethal-heat claims. Without a partner sensor this EMIV stays unidentified (UNKNOWN), not SST-filled.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PRIVATE; bag/bed GPS and lease corners NEVER_PUBLISH publicly; public grain growing-area or coarser

variable_name: Coastal sea level and storm-driven water level
definition: Observed or analyzed coastal water level including non-tidal residual (storm surge, seiche, seasonal mean). Distinct from purely astronomical tide (EMIV-PHY-TIDE-001) though they share gauges. Altimetric SSH is a related open-ocean measurement, not a tide-gauge substitute in Willapa.
biological_relevance: Extreme inundation/drainage of intertidal habitat; coastal flooding of farms. Not abundance.
preferred_measurement_methods: CO-OPS/GLOSS tide gauges (observed)
valid_proxy_methods: Altimetry/CMEMS zos as offshore SSH context; storm-surge models with QUID
uncertainty_method: Gauge QC; model QUID; UNKNOWN at ungaged estuaries
source_standards: GOOS EOV Sea Surface Height. IOOS core: Sea level. GLOSS.
minimum_quality_threshold: Datum named; predicted-only series must not be labeled observed residual
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC

definition: Metrics of vertical structure: mixed-layer depth, density/temperature stratification, thermocline depth. Explains when SST ≠ bulk/bottom T and when hypoxia can isolate below the pycnocline.
unit: m (MLD); kg m-3 or degC difference as documented
biological_relevance: Controls oxygen isolation, subsurface thermal refuge, and SST-proxy validity.
preferred_measurement_methods: CTD profiles, gliders, moored strings
valid_proxy_methods: OFS mlotst / density profiles; Argo-based MLD climatology labeled climatology
uncertainty_method: Algorithm sensitivity; UNKNOWN if inferred from SST alone
source_standards: Derived from GOOS subsurface T/S EOVs. CMEMS mlotst as a product example not a standard.
minimum_quality_threshold: Must not be inferred from SST-only. State algorithm.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC

definition: Seafloor depth / elevation relative to a named vertical datum. Static-to-slowly-changing habitat geometry. Not a navigation product even when GEBCO/ENC-derived.
biological_relevance: Habitat placement, wave shoaling, intertidal extent, shelf-vs-canyon. Not a fish count.
taxonomic_relevance: Universal geometry; high for benthic and depth-associated taxa.
spatial_scale: global GEBCO to local surveys; grain UNKNOWN vs lease creeks
preferred_measurement_methods: Hydrographic surveys, NOAA coastal relief, GEBCO with not-for-navigation notice
valid_proxy_methods: Charted depths with CATZOC uncertainty; satellite-derived bathymetry only in clear shallow water and labeled as such
required_metadata: vertical_datum; source_year; not_for_navigation; uncertainty_class if any
uncertainty_method: Source CATZOC/GEBCO TID if present; otherwise UNKNOWN. Do not invent contour precision.
update_expectation: static until a new survey vintage
source_standards: IOOS core: Bathymetry. GEBCO. No single GOOS 'bathymetry EOV' in the physics EOV list; still an IOOS core variable. https://ioos.noaa.gov/about/ioos-by-the-numbers/
minimum_quality_threshold: Datum named; navigation use forbidden in product copy
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC for broad bathymetry; unpublished high-res over remnant reefs/beds may be COARSENED/NEVER_PUBLISH

definition: Seafloor substrate class (rock, gravel, sand, mud, shell, mixed) and/or hardness. Slow-changing habitat, not a daily abundance layer.
biological_relevance: Shelter and gear suitability (e.g. lobster rocky cover). Weak as 72 h oyster mortality.
taxonomic_relevance: Benthic crustaceans, demersal fishes, infauna; culture-method dependent for oysters.
spatial_scale: 100m_to_km typical public maps; finer surveys often restricted
preferred_measurement_methods: Grab/video ground-truth, multibeam backscatter classified with in situ labels
valid_proxy_methods: Coarse benthic habitat maps; do not treat as daily state
uncertainty_method: Class confusion matrix if published; otherwise UNKNOWN
source_standards: IOOS core: Bottom character. GOOS habitat-forming ecosystem EOVs are biological cover, not grain-size.
minimum_quality_threshold: Scheme named; no false daily precision
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: COARSENED if map reveals remnant high-value beds; else PUBLIC at published grain

definition: Downwelling irradiance, PAR, and/or Kd (e.g. Kd(490)). Sets photic habitat and ocean-color interpretability. Does not count animals below the optical depth.
biological_relevance: Primary production, visual foraging, seagrass/coral photic limits. Optical depth bounds what satellites can see.
taxonomic_relevance: Photoautotrophs and visual predators; not a fish census.
preferred_measurement_methods: In-water radiometers; BGC-Argo irradiance; Kd from calibrated ocean color
valid_proxy_methods: Satellite Kd/PAR products with coastal CDOM/sediment caveat
uncertainty_method: Optical closure if available; coastal RMSE UNKNOWN
source_standards: GOOS EOV Ocean Colour (optical). IOOS core: Optical properties. Jerlov/Kd practice.
minimum_quality_threshold: Band and algorithm named; do not treat as animal detection
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC

definition: Concentration (or percent saturation if separately labeled) of dissolved oxygen in seawater. Causal hypoxia co-stressor with heat and neap tides in Puget Sound summer oyster mortality; vertical habitat cap during upwelling hypoxia. No satellite DO.
unit: umol kg-1 or mg L-1 as documented; percent saturation only if labeled
biological_relevance: Aerobic metabolism; mass mortality in stratified basins; habitat squeeze for fishes.
taxonomic_relevance: High for sessile bivalves in poorly flushed basins and for demersal fishes; W1 relevant where local sensors exist. Hood Canal ≠ Willapa.
depth_relevance: depth-specific; bottom DO ≠ surface DO when stratified
preferred_measurement_methods: Optical/Clark sondes, Winkler calibration, ORCA/NERRS/Ecology, BGC-Argo O2
valid_proxy_methods: None from SST. OFS BGC O2 only with published coastal skill (often poor in estuaries). Do not impute from temperature.
required_metadata: unit; depth_m; temperature for saturation; calibration; as_of
uncertainty_method: QARTOD DO; drift/biofouling. UNKNOWN at ungaged leases.
source_standards: GOOS EOV Oxygen. IOOS core: Dissolved oxygen. https://goosocean.org/document-list/168
minimum_quality_threshold: Depth and unit known; QC pass. Missing DO must remain UNKNOWN — never SST-filled.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC after licence

definition: Seawater pH. Impairs larval calcification (2009 WA oyster seed crisis). Weak as a 72 h adult farm-mortality driver. Not a harvest-legal or food-safety stamp.
unit: 1 (total scale pH); scale must be named
biological_relevance: Larval/early-life carbonate stress; adult 72 h pathway weak.
taxonomic_relevance: Calcifiers (oyster larvae, pteropods, corals); not W1 adult ops headline.
preferred_measurement_methods: Spectrophotometric pH, calibrated ISFET, NOAA OAP, NANOOS carbonate
valid_proxy_methods: pCO2+TA models with uncertainty; do not use SST-only OA indices as pH
uncertainty_method: OAP protocols; UNKNOWN if scale omitted
update_expectation: hours_to_days at carbonate sites; else sparse
source_standards: GOOS EOV Inorganic Carbon (pH related). IOOS core: Acidity.
minimum_quality_threshold: Scale named. Do not headline for W1 adult 72 h mortality.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC after licence

definition: Dissolved inorganic nitrogen, phosphate, and silicate as documented species. Fuels phytoplankton and some HABs; indirect for 72 h farm mortality.
unit: umol L-1 or umol kg-1 as documented
biological_relevance: Bottom-up production; HAB preconditioning. Not fish abundance; not 72 h oyster kill.
preferred_measurement_methods: GO-SHIP/WOCE nutrients, Ecology/NERRS bottles, BGC-Argo nitrate
valid_proxy_methods: Modeled NO3 (CMEMS BGC) as MODEL-INFERRED; river load estimates
uncertainty_method: Lab QC; model QUID; UNKNOWN real-time at most farms
source_standards: GOOS EOV Nutrients. IOOS core: Dissolved nutrients.
minimum_quality_threshold: Analyte named; do not treat as HAB toxin or oyster food quality
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC after licence

definition: Chlorophyll-a concentration as pigment / ocean-color retrieval. Indexes phytoplankton biomass proxy, not taxon, not toxin, not fish, not planted oyster stock. Coastal CDOM/sediment contamination is first-order. Claim-class if anyone promotes it as animals: invalid (see EMIV-BIO-CHLN-001).
biological_relevance: Food/productivity context; weak as 72 h mortality unless a crash/HAB. Juvenile salmon habitat literature must not be applied as adult 48 h encounter.
temporal_scale: daily with cloud gaps; 8-day composites leak if used as-of
depth_relevance: optical near-surface; not the deep chlorophyll maximum unless profiled
preferred_measurement_methods: HPLC/fluorometry in situ; OC algorithms with flags (VIIRS, OLCI, PACE)
valid_proxy_methods: Fluorescence (needs quenching correction); CMEMS BGC chl as model
uncertainty_method: Matchup RMSE if published for that product/region; otherwise UNKNOWN. Do not invent.
source_standards: GOOS EOV Ocean Colour / Phytoplankton biomass related. IOOS core: Ocean color. GEO BON EBV: Primary productivity related (not this pigment itself).
minimum_quality_threshold: Flags pass; never as fish/oyster abundance; 8-day composite cannot be a 72 h feature without as_of freeze
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC after licence

definition: Rate of autotrophic production (net or gross as labeled). Model or incubation-derived. Not chlorophyll, not fish biomass.
unit: mg C m-2 d-1 or equivalent as documented
biological_relevance: Ecosystem energy input; seasonal context. Not 24–72 h encounter.
preferred_measurement_methods: 14C/13C incubations; in situ sensors with published algorithms
valid_proxy_methods: Satellite NPP algorithms (VGPM-class) labeled MODEL-INFERRED
uncertainty_method: Algorithm family uncertainty; regional RMSE UNKNOWN unless cited
source_standards: GEO BON EBV: Primary productivity. GOOS phytoplankton / ocean colour related. https://geobon.org/ebvs/what-are-ebvs/
minimum_quality_threshold: Must state algorithm and that it is not animal abundance
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC after licence

definition: Optical turbidity and/or TSS. Clogs bivalve feeding; rises with runoff and storms; co-stressor in flood mortality literature. Also contaminates ocean-color chl.
unit: NTU/FNU and/or mg L-1 TSS as documented
biological_relevance: Feeding inhibition; light limitation. Conditional W1 co-stressor.
taxonomic_relevance: Filter feeders; seagrass light; visual predators.
preferred_measurement_methods: Nephelometers at NERRS/farms; gravimetric TSS
valid_proxy_methods: Satellite TSM/Kd in turbid water with caution; USGS discharge as event proxy
uncertainty_method: Calibration to local TSS UNKNOWN until paired
source_standards: IOOS core: Total suspended matter. GOOS particulate matter related.
minimum_quality_threshold: Unit named; do not equate to HAB cells
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC after licence

definition: Dissolved inorganic carbon, total alkalinity, and/or pCO2 as documented. Carbonate-system state, not a biological count, not food-safety.
biological_relevance: Calcification environment; climate carbon. Weak 72 h adult oyster.
preferred_measurement_methods: Bottle chemistry, underway pCO2, NOAA OAP, SOCAT
valid_proxy_methods: Empirical TA-salinity; modeled DIC
uncertainty_method: OAP/SOCAT protocols
update_expectation: sparse to daily at time series
source_standards: GOOS EOV Inorganic Carbon. IOOS core: Partial pressure of CO2.
minimum_quality_threshold: Parameter named; complete system needs at least two carbonate vars + T/S
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC after licence

definition: Saturation state of aragonite (Ω_ar). Derived carbonate metric used in OA and larval-shellfish work. Not adult 72 h mortality; not harvest authority.
biological_relevance: Larval calcification threshold literature. Wrong stage for W1 adult farm 72 h.
preferred_measurement_methods: Calculated from measured carbonate system (CO2SYS-class) with documented constants
valid_proxy_methods: Modeled Ω; never SST-only
uncertainty_method: Propagated carbonate uncertainty; UNKNOWN if inputs incomplete
source_standards: Derived from GOOS Inorganic Carbon EOV. NOAA OAP practice.
minimum_quality_threshold: Inputs measured not guessed; exclude as W1 adult headline
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC after licence

variable_name: Chemical pollutants / contaminants in water or sediment
definition: Measured contaminant concentrations (metals, organics, hydrocarbons, etc. as named). Environmental chemistry, not an official harvest determination (that is EMIV-HUM-HARV-001).
biological_relevance: Toxicity, sublethal stress. Event-scale; often unobserved at leases.
taxonomic_relevance: Depends on analyte; bivalves as integrators.
preferred_measurement_methods: Accredited lab chemistry; agency monitoring
valid_proxy_methods: None without named analyte. Spill reports are events not concentrations.
uncertainty_method: Lab QA/QC; UNKNOWN if anecdotal
source_standards: IOOS core: Contaminants. No single GOOS contaminant EOV.
minimum_quality_threshold: Analyte and method named; do not impersonate NSSP
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: RESTRICTED/PUBLIC per agency; do not add targeting of outfalls beyond official maps

definition: Delivery of freshwater (and associated sediment/nutrients/contaminants) to an estuary. Proxy for salinity and turbidity pulses, not a direct oyster measurement. Also used in some NSSP conditional-area hydrology rules — those rules are harvest constraints (EMIV-HUM-HARV-001), not ops-mortality labels.
biological_relevance: Estuarine salinity/turbidity/contaminant pulses; plume structure.
preferred_measurement_methods: USGS gauges; NWS QPF/observed precip
valid_proxy_methods: Ungauged-basin estimates labeled UNKNOWN skill
uncertainty_method: Gauge rating; QPF uncertainty qualitative; estuary mixing UNKNOWN
source_standards: IOOS core: Stream flow. Superset relative to GOOS ocean EOVs (land hydrology).
minimum_quality_threshold: Gauge identified or QPF labeled forecast. Not a DOH closure substitute.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC

definition: Fecal coliform / E. coli / enterococci as measured water-quality indicators. Input to NSSP growing-area classification. Not oyster physiological stress, not ops_disruption_72h, not a FishAI harvest authorization.
unit: MPN or CFU per 100 mL as documented
biological_relevance: Human-health harvest rules, not Magallana gigas heat-kill.
taxonomic_relevance: Public-health indicator organisms; not marine biodiversity abundance.
preferred_measurement_methods: Official NSSP laboratory methods via the authority
valid_proxy_methods: None for legal classification. Rainfall/discharge may trigger conditional rules but do not replace lab results.
uncertainty_method: Lab MPN uncertainty; spatial representativeness UNKNOWN
update_expectation: program schedule (often weekly-to-event); not a 72 h nowcast
source_standards: IOOS core: Pathogens (indicator subset). NSSP. WA DOH growing areas https://doh.wa.gov/community-and-environment/shellfish/growing-areas
minimum_quality_threshold: Official lab only for any legal overlay. FishAI must not re-derive NSSP class.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC at official growing-area grain; station microdata follow agency rules

definition: CDOM absorption/fluorescence. Optical water-quality and ocean-color contamination term. Not chlorophyll and not a bloom taxon.
unit: m-1 (aCDOM at named wavelength) or FDOM as documented
biological_relevance: Light field and satellite chl bias in coastal water.
preferred_measurement_methods: AC-s / spectrophotometer; FDOM sondes
valid_proxy_methods: Satellite CDOM algorithms with Case-2 caveat
uncertainty_method: Optical calibration; satellite RMSE UNKNOWN coastal
source_standards: IOOS core: Colored dissolved organic matter.
minimum_quality_threshold: Do not report as chlorophyll or HAB
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC

definition: Claim-class: DIRECT_DETECTION of a named taxon in a space-time unit (visual, validated acoustic ID, camera, catch of that taxon, verified stranding) OR documented ABSENCE only under a stated detection protocol. Not habitat suitability, not eDNA reads-as-count, not CPUE, not abundance. eDNA positives belong primarily to EMIV-BIO-EDNA-001.
unit: presence/absence with protocol; not a count
biological_relevance: Foundation for distribution and occupancy. Historical occurrence ≠ current presence.
taxonomic_relevance: Any WoRMS taxon; sensitivity follows taxon × life-history (spawning, listed, rare).
spatial_scale: protocol unit; public grain per sensitive_location_policy
depth_relevance: as observed; often unknown in aggregator records
preferred_measurement_methods: Protocol surveys, validated imagery, observer/catch identification, acoustic ID with voucher/validation
valid_proxy_methods: None that convert suitability or vessel density into occurrence. Aggregator records (OBIS/GBIF) are SURVEY-DERIVED compilations with bias.
required_metadata: AphiaID; claim-class; protocol; coordinateUncertainty; basisOfRecord; as_of; detection_effort (EMIV-QUA-SEFFORT-001)
uncertainty_method: Detection probability (EMIV-QUA-PDETECT-001); do not treat non-detection as absence without effort.
update_expectation: as surveys accrue; not real-time tracking
source_standards: GEO BON EBV: Species distributions (occurrence grain). GOOS BioEco taxon EOVs (Fish, mammals, turtles, etc.) at occurrence level. Darwin Core. https://geobon.org/ebvs/what-are-ebvs/
minimum_quality_threshold: Taxon ID + claim-class + effort or explicit UNKNOWN effort. Listed/rare native GPS NEVER_PUBLISH.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: NEVER_PUBLISH at native grain for nests, spawning aggregations, rare/listed, haul-outs; else COARSENED/DELAYED per observatory/sensitive_location_policy.md

definition: Claim-class: DIRECT_COUNT of individuals (or colonies) inside a fully enumerated survey unit with a stated protocol (quadrat, census of a haul-out under permit, farm bag count by the operator of their stock). Does not generalize outside the unit. Planted farm stock is an operator count of culture, not wild abundance.
biological_relevance: True counts are rare in the ocean; do not infer from SST/AIS/chl.
taxonomic_relevance: Any taxon under protocol; farmed oysters are counted by farmers (not a wild census).
preferred_measurement_methods: Design-based counts; farm inventory of planted stock (PRIVATE)
valid_proxy_methods: None. Indices and CPUE are other EMIVs.
uncertainty_method: Count error/missed individuals; binomial/Poisson only if protocol supports it
source_standards: GEO BON EBV: Species abundances (direct). GOOS Fish abundance and distribution EOV — only the direct-count subset.
minimum_quality_threshold: Protocol + unit. Public direct counts of sensitive aggregations NEVER_PUBLISH.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PRIVATE for farm inventories; NEVER_PUBLISH for sensitive wild aggregations at native grain

definition: Claim-class: SURVEY_INDEX of relative abundance from a documented fishery-independent design (trawl, trap survey, BRUV MaxN, acoustic NASC with TS model). Not a census, not CPUE from the commercial fishery, not habitat suitability. Calibration to absolute N is usually UNKNOWN.
unit: index units as protocol (e.g. n per tow, MaxN, NASC)
biological_relevance: Stock-assessment and ecology; seasonal-to-annual, rarely 24–72 h.
taxonomic_relevance: Survey target taxa; bycatch ID quality varies (EMIV-QUA-TAXCONF-001).
preferred_measurement_methods: Published survey protocols (e.g. NEFSC BTS, Maine VTS) with design metadata
valid_proxy_methods: None to convert index to census without a peer-reviewed catchability model
required_metadata: survey_id; gear; effort; stratum; year; revision_flag (assessments revise)
uncertainty_method: Design-based CVs if published; FishAI must not invent them
source_standards: GEO BON EBV: Species abundances (index grain). GOOS Fish abundance and distribution EOV. ICES/NOAA survey manuals.
minimum_quality_threshold: Design cited. Do not downscale annual indices to 48 h maps.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: COARSENED public; haul GPS often RESTRICTED/confidential

definition: Claim-class: CPUE — catch divided by a defined effort unit (soak-hours, trap-hauls, charter angler-hours). Operational observation of the catch process. Not abundance (hyperstability, catchability, saturation, regulations). Evaluation metric for some fisheries products; never a public biomass heatmap.
biological_relevance: Encounter/catchability plus local density, confounded. Weather and rules dominate short horizons.
taxonomic_relevance: Target and bycatch as identified; legal selectivity applies (vents, size, season).
spatial_scale: trip/string to statistical area; public grain coarsened
preferred_measurement_methods: Partner logbooks under DUA; observer programs; research fleets (CFRF)
valid_proxy_methods: Public landings without effort are NOT CPUE. AIS is NOT effort-complete.
required_metadata: effort_definition; legal_selectivity; area_open_mask; soak/bait if traps; as_of
uncertainty_method: Reporting bias; zero-inflation; do not convert to N
update_expectation: per trip if partner; public series lagged
source_standards: Not an EBV of abundance. Related to GOOS Fish EOV only as a fishery-dependent observation class. Harley et al. 2001 CPUE≠N.
minimum_quality_threshold: Effort denominator required. Confidential VTR/LEEDS not public GT. Native waypoints NEVER_PUBLISH.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PRIVATE/NEVER_PUBLISH at native fishing grain; public only official aggregates

definition: Claim-class: DIRECT_WEIGHED biomass in a unit, or an INDEX converted via a documented length-weight/TS model. Acoustic biomass without species ID and TS is not this EMIV. Not chlorophyll, not vessel tonnage.
unit: kg or t per stated unit
biological_relevance: Stock and ecosystem models; rarely identifiable at 24–72 h without survey.
taxonomic_relevance: Named taxon or documented mixed-species TS model.
preferred_measurement_methods: Weighed samples; calibrated acoustics plus ID; census of cultured biomass on a farm (PRIVATE)
valid_proxy_methods: Length-frequency × LW keys; stock-assessment biomass is a MODEL with lag — not a nowcast
uncertainty_method: Published assessment CVs or UNKNOWN; never fake ±
source_standards: GEO BON EBV: Species abundances (biomass grain). GOOS Fish / Zooplankton biomass EOVs.
minimum_quality_threshold: Conversion model cited or DIRECT_WEIGHED. Uncalibrated NASC ≠ this EMIV.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PRIVATE farm biomass; wild assessment tables at published grain only

definition: Claim-class: RANGE_ENVELOPE or compiled distribution (historical occurrence hull, expert range, IUCN map). Not current presence, not abundance, not a 72 h forecast. IUCN spatial layers may be non-commercial — rights UNKNOWN until reviewed.
unit: spatial unit (EEZ, LME, 0.1 deg, expert polygon) as documented
biological_relevance: Coarse biogeography and seasonality priors.
taxonomic_relevance: Species to stock; WoRMS AphiaID required.
preferred_measurement_methods: Compiled occurrence after bias review; expert maps with citation
valid_proxy_methods: Suitability envelopes must be labeled EMIV-BIO-SUIT-001, not distribution observed
uncertainty_method: Commission/omission UNKNOWN unless assessed
source_standards: GEO BON EBV: Species distributions. GOOS taxon distribution EOVs.
minimum_quality_threshold: Do not display as current condition. Sensitive ranges coarsened.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: COARSENED; never native nests/aggregations

definition: Claim-class: DIRECT stage/age/size-class composition from samples, or an INDEX (e.g. settlement collectors). Mixing juvenile habitat papers into adult encounter models is a category error (W2).
unit: proportion or count by stage class
biological_relevance: Catchability, vulnerability, legal size, spawning condition confounders.
preferred_measurement_methods: Bio samples, settlement surveys, farm seed vs adult logs
valid_proxy_methods: Degree-day phenology indices labeled as indices (EMIV-BIO-PHENO-001)
uncertainty_method: Sample size; UNKNOWN if calendar-only
source_standards: GEO BON EBV: Species traits / populations structure. GOOS Fish EOV sub-variable.
minimum_quality_threshold: Stage scheme named; do not transfer juvenile papers to adult 48 h products
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: RESTRICTED for unpublished surveys; farm stage PRIVATE

definition: Claim-class: DIRECT length/weight/morphology measurements, not inferred from pixels without a published allometry. GEO BON morphology trait.
biological_relevance: Legal size, fecundity, TS, trophic position.
preferred_measurement_methods: Board/scale protocols; stereo-BRUV with calibration
valid_proxy_methods: Published LW keys; uncalibrated image size UNKNOWN
uncertainty_method: Measurement error; gear selectivity bias
source_standards: GEO BON EBV: Morphology. https://geobon.org/ebvs/what-are-ebvs/
minimum_quality_threshold: Length type named
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: Generally low; join to locations follows occurrence policy

definition: Claim-class: LABORATORY genetics (richness, heterozygosity, effective size, stock ID). Not occurrence, not eDNA occupancy. Farm genetics are proprietary.
biological_relevance: Stock structure, adaptation, hatchery vs wild.
preferred_measurement_methods: Peer-reviewed genomic/genetic assays
valid_proxy_methods: None from ocean color
uncertainty_method: Sampling variance; UNKNOWN if n small
source_standards: GEO BON EBV class: Genetic composition. https://geobon.org/ebvs/what-are-ebvs/
minimum_quality_threshold: Assay cited. Farm genetics NEVER_PUBLISH.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PRIVATE/NEVER_PUBLISH for farm and many stock files; public only published summaries

definition: Claim-class: ASSEMBLAGE composition from a protocol (net, BRUV, eDNA community index). Diversity metrics are indices, not abundances of a target commercial species.
unit: relative abundance / incidence matrix as protocol
biological_relevance: Ecosystem state; bycatch context.
preferred_measurement_methods: Quantitative community surveys; metabarcoding with occupancy interpretation
valid_proxy_methods: Ocean color PFTs are phytoplankton community proxies, not fish communities
uncertainty_method: Detection and ID error
source_standards: GEO BON EBV class: Community composition. GOOS plankton diversity EOVs.
minimum_quality_threshold: Protocol + authority. eDNA community ≠ fish census.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: Rare/listed members NEVER_PUBLISH at native stations

definition: Claim-class: OBSERVED timing of biological events (spawn, settlement, molt, bloom, migration) or a DOCUMENTED INDEX (degree-days). Calendar-only is a prior, not an observation. Lobster molt ~5–6 C then degree-days (Mills et al. 2017) is seasonal, not next-haul N.
biological_relevance: Catchability and vulnerability windows; oyster ripe-summer confounder.
preferred_measurement_methods: Sea sampling, settlement plates, tagged molt, farm condition index
valid_proxy_methods: Degree-day models labeled INDEX; moon phase is not a validated W1/W3 independent driver
uncertainty_method: Event detection effort; model error UNKNOWN until scored
source_standards: GEO BON EBV: Phenology (species traits) and Ecosystem phenology.
minimum_quality_threshold: Do not use as 72 h mortality nowcast without a stated mechanism
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: Spawning timing at aggregations NEVER_PUBLISH at native grain

definition: Claim-class: TELEMETRY_INDIVIDUAL or direct behavioral observation. Individuals ≠ population. Raw tracks of sensitive taxa are NEVER_PUBLISH. Not AIS of vessels.
biological_relevance: Habitat-use models from tagged subset (biased).
preferred_measurement_methods: Acoustic/satellite/GPS tags under permits; camera ethograms
valid_proxy_methods: None from vessel AIS
uncertainty_method: Location class; Argos error; surface-drift of pop-ups
source_standards: GEO BON movement-related trait (see EBV strategy). GOOS AniBOS network. IOOS ATN.
minimum_quality_threshold: No public live tracks. No population inference without a stated model.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: NEVER_PUBLISH raw tracks for turtles, mammals, sawfish, aggregation sharks; DELAYED coarsened only after harm review

definition: Claim-class: SUITABILITY or Category D relative habitat/encounter/risk likelihood from environment + (optional) occurrence training. Explicitly not current presence, not abundance, not harvest legality, not food safety, not a catch guarantee. Public biology default with uncertainty.
unit: dimensionless score / rank / probability of habitat as labeled
biological_relevance: Where conditions could support a taxon; ceiling is Category D.
taxonomic_relevance: Named taxon and life stage required (stage mismatch is a defect).
spatial_scale: model grid; must not be finer than evidence
temporal_scale: climatology to short-horizon physics-driven risk (W1 stress is ECO-OPSOUT evaluated, not this row alone)
depth_relevance: must be depth-aware or explicitly surface-only
preferred_measurement_methods: SDM/habitat models with blocked CV; expert rules labeled as rules
valid_proxy_methods: Thermal envelopes from literature as RULES not as ML abundance
required_metadata: claim-class=SUITABILITY; stage; horizon; training_years; not_presence flag
uncertainty_method: Spatial block CV; calibration; else rank-only
update_expectation: as env inputs; skill UNKNOWN until scored
source_standards: Not a GEO BON species-abundance EBV. Related to ecosystem structure / habitat. FishAI prediction contract Category D.
minimum_quality_threshold: Label must say suitability. SST-only Chinook 48 h SDM not identified in literature reviewed 2026-09-18.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: COARSENED; must not invert to nests/aggregations (reverse-engineering tests)

definition: Claim-class: MOLECULAR_OCCUPANCY_INDEX. Detected DNA means molecules were on the filter. Not a live GPS, not abundance, not biomass. Persistence often hours to ~1–2 days; transport meters to tens of km. Rare/listed positives at native coordinates NEVER_PUBLISH.
unit: detection / qPCR copies / reads as protocol — not individuals
biological_relevance: Occupancy and community screening.
preferred_measurement_methods: QA/QC qPCR or metabarcoding with extraction blanks and occupancy models
valid_proxy_methods: None to invert to N without an identified model (generally underdetermined)
uncertainty_method: Occupancy p/r; transport UNKNOWN without local study
source_standards: Emerging GOOS microbes / BioEco practice; GEO BON genetic/community related. NOAA Omics.
minimum_quality_threshold: Blanks + taxon resolution stated. DNA ≠ count.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: NEVER_PUBLISH rare/listed/aggregation positives at native GPS; common taxa COARSENED

definition: Claim-class: invalid. Satellite or model SST does not count fish, shellfish, or lobster. Registrar ruling: do not instantiate this as a biodiversity EMIV. Use EMIV-PHY-SST-001 / EMIV-PHY-WTEMP-* as physics only.
biological_relevance: None as abundance. Documented mismatches: oyster aerial heat; Chinook 3D habitat; lobster bottom T.
preferred_measurement_methods: n/a — rejected
valid_proxy_methods: n/a
uncertainty_method: n/a
source_standards: Fails GOOS Fish abundance EOV and GEO BON Species abundances (wrong measurand).
minimum_quality_threshold: Always fail acceptance gate as abundance
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: n/a (do not publish as biology)

variable_name: REJECTED: taxon abundance from AIS/vessel density
definition: Claim-class: invalid. AIS/VMS/GFW are vessel activity. Registrar ruling: map those sources to EMIV-HUM-AIS-001 / EMIV-HUM-FISH-001 / EMIV-HUM-SHIP-001 only. Never to abundance.
biological_relevance: None as abundance. Incomplete carriage; switch-off; class bias.
preferred_measurement_methods: n/a — rejected
valid_proxy_methods: n/a
uncertainty_method: n/a
source_standards: Fails GOOS Fish abundance EOV. GFW is NC and not ingested here.
minimum_quality_threshold: Always fail as abundance
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: Vessel identity NEVER_PUBLISH; competitor tracking banned

variable_name: REJECTED: taxon abundance from chlorophyll/ocean color
definition: Claim-class: invalid. Chlorophyll is a pigment/ocean-color retrieval. Registrar ruling: map to EMIV-BGC-CHL-001. Not Chinook, lobster, or oyster abundance (oyster stock is planted).
biological_relevance: None as metazoan abundance.
preferred_measurement_methods: n/a — rejected
valid_proxy_methods: n/a
uncertainty_method: n/a
source_standards: Fails GEO BON Species abundances. Ocean colour EOV is BGC/phytoplankton.
minimum_quality_threshold: Always fail as animal abundance
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: n/a

definition: Availability of named prey (forage fish, zooplankton, etc.). Claim as survey index or model, not as predator count. Fine-scale public forage maps can leak fishing and listed-predator aggregations.
biological_relevance: Predator encounter and condition at seasonal scales; rarely 48 h.
preferred_measurement_methods: Acoustics+ID, nets, diet studies
valid_proxy_methods: Chl as forage is a weak proxy (EMIV-BGC-CHL-001) and must stay labeled proxy
uncertainty_method: Survey CV or UNKNOWN
source_standards: GOOS Zooplankton / Fish EOVs as prey. GEO BON interaction-related.
minimum_quality_threshold: Named prey. No lawful fine public Chinook forage product at 48 h identified.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: HIGH; coarsen; do not map listed-predator feeding GPS

definition: Presence/pressure of named predators on a target taxon. Do not map protected mammals or sharks at native grain. Unobserved at 48 h for Chinook wedge.
biological_relevance: Behavior and survival; often UNKNOWN at product horizon.
preferred_measurement_methods: Diet/scat/observer under permit
valid_proxy_methods: None from AIS of whale-watch boats
uncertainty_method: Usually UNKNOWN
source_standards: GOOS Marine mammal EOV is the predator's biology — still not a public targeting layer.
minimum_quality_threshold: No public mammal/shark pins
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: NEVER_PUBLISH native mammal/aggregation predator locations

definition: Network or trophic-level description (diet matrices, EwE-class). Year-scale ecosystem models, not 72 h nowcasts, not a species-N engine.
biological_relevance: Strategic ecosystem context.
preferred_measurement_methods: Diet studies; Ecopath/Atlantis research
valid_proxy_methods: Stable isotopes as trophic index
uncertainty_method: Structural UNKNOWN
source_standards: GEO BON Ecosystem functioning. Not a GOOS 72 h EOV product.
minimum_quality_threshold: Do not serve as operational species forecast
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC at published-model grain

definition: Area of a named habitat type (estuary, reef, intertidal bed, growing area). Geometry, not quality and not animal count. Official growing-area polygons are spatial frame plus harvest overlay, not oyster N.
biological_relevance: Denominator for density; spatial mask.
preferred_measurement_methods: Official polygons; classified habitat maps at published grain
valid_proxy_methods: Coarse shoreline; not VHR unpublished remnants
uncertainty_method: Mapping error UNKNOWN unless reported
source_standards: GEO BON EBV: Ecosystem distribution / live cover. GOOS seagrass/coral/macroalgae extent EOVs.
minimum_quality_threshold: Authority named. Unpublished remnant thickets NEVER_PUBLISH.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: Official MPA/growing-area PUBLIC as published; remnant unpublished habitat NEVER_PUBLISH

definition: Condition/quality of a named habitat (stress, fragmentation, suitability of the place). Not extent, not census of occupants. Coral DHW is heat stress not live coral count.
biological_relevance: Stress and recovery context.
preferred_measurement_methods: In situ condition protocols; CRW-type heat-stress as named proxy
valid_proxy_methods: SST DHW for coral heat stress only, labeled PROXY
uncertainty_method: Proxy mismatch must be stated
source_standards: GOOS hard-coral / seagrass condition sub-variables. NOAA CRW is heat-stress not cover.
minimum_quality_threshold: Do not label DHW as coral abundance
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC for official stress products; site-level rare coral NEVER_PUBLISH

definition: Hard-coral cover/composition from benthic protocol or published maps. Not DHW. Unpublished remnant thickets NEVER_PUBLISH.
biological_relevance: Habitat-forming ecosystem EOV.
spatial_scale: reef site to region at published grain
preferred_measurement_methods: Photoquadrat/transect; published atlas
valid_proxy_methods: Clear-water satellite benthic class with in situ labels; DHW is not cover
uncertainty_method: Observer/class error
source_standards: GOOS Hard coral EOV. IOOS core: Hard coral cover and composition. GEO BON live cover.
minimum_quality_threshold: Protocol or published map grain only
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: NEVER_PUBLISH unpublished remnant sites; official maps at published grain

definition: Canopy-forming macroalgae extent/composition. Floating Sargassum is a different surface-mat product and must be labeled as such.
biological_relevance: Habitat and production.
preferred_measurement_methods: Survey; Landsat/Sentinel kelp indices with validation
valid_proxy_methods: Satellite canopy indices labeled remotely detected canopy not fish
uncertainty_method: Cloud/glint/submergence bias
source_standards: GOOS Macroalgae EOV. IOOS core: Macroalgal canopy cover and composition.
minimum_quality_threshold: Do not treat as fish abundance
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC at published grain

definition: Seagrass cover/composition. Fine unpublished remnant patches COARSENED or NEVER_PUBLISH.
biological_relevance: Nursery/habitat EOV.
preferred_measurement_methods: In situ mapping; official habitat maps
valid_proxy_methods: Clear-water optics with validation
uncertainty_method: Mapping error
source_standards: GOOS Seagrass EOV. IOOS core: Seagrass cover and composition.
minimum_quality_threshold: Unpublished remnants not public at native GPS
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: COARSENED or NEVER_PUBLISH for unpublished remnants

definition: Named pathogen or disease state in a host (e.g. OsHV-1 in oysters). Causal where present. USDA-ARS PSBC: OsHV-1 not detected at OR/WA test sites in 2020 — do not assume WA 72 h driver. Farm disease attributed NEVER_PUBLISH.
biological_relevance: Mass mortality where present.
preferred_measurement_methods: Accredited diagnostics; sentinel programs
valid_proxy_methods: None from SST
uncertainty_method: Assay LOD; sampling
source_standards: No dedicated GOOS disease EOV. Veterinary/diagnostic standards.
minimum_quality_threshold: Do not import CA OsHV-1 into WA W1 without local detection
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: NEVER_PUBLISH attributed farm outbreaks; PRIVATE to partner

definition: Cell counts or detections of named HAB taxa that can reduce feeding or stress animals (e.g. Heterosigma). Distinct from NSSP tissue-toxin harvest lists (those constrain EMIV-HUM-HARV-001). SoundToxins is partner-gated. Not ops GT.
unit: cells L-1 or presence as protocol
biological_relevance: Conditional W1 co-stressor; ecosystem disruption.
preferred_measurement_methods: Microscopy/qPCR programs (SoundToxins, state HAB)
valid_proxy_methods: Satellite chl/FLH as bloom PROXY not taxon/toxin
uncertainty_method: Count protocol; satellite false positives coastal
update_expectation: weekly in-season typical; not guaranteed 72 h
source_standards: GOOS Harmful Algal Blooms EOV. IOOS phytoplankton related. https://soundtoxins.org/about.html
minimum_quality_threshold: Split stress taxa from PSP/DSP/ASP harvest lists. Do not impersonate biotoxin reopen.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: Partner maps may be RESTRICTED; official bulletins as published

definition: Integrated ecosystem production (beyond instantaneous NPP): secondary production, energy to higher trophic levels. Seasonal-to-year. Not trap CPUE, not fish N.
biological_relevance: Context prior, not 72 h label.
preferred_measurement_methods: Survey time series; ecosystem models
valid_proxy_methods: Chl/NPP as incomplete proxy
uncertainty_method: UNKNOWN at short horizon
source_standards: GEO BON EBV: Primary productivity / ecosystem functioning. GOOS phytoplankton.
minimum_quality_threshold: Not a next-trip lobster or 48 h Chinook feature
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC at published grain

definition: Places and times of reproduction, nursery, nesting, pupping, haul-out. Native grain is NEVER_PUBLISH (observatory sensitive_location_policy §6). Not a public heatmap. Internal use only under ACL + harm review.
biological_relevance: Critical life-history habitat; direct IUU/harassment intelligence if leaked.
taxonomic_relevance: Grouper/snapper aggregations, salmon holding, turtle beaches, mammal pupping, etc.
preferred_measurement_methods: Permitted scientific survey; official critical habitat polygons as the authority publishes them
valid_proxy_methods: Official ESA critical habitat / Slow Zone as published — do not densify
uncertainty_method: n/a for withheld; official polygons as published
source_standards: GOOS Fish abundance and distribution (habitat subset) + EBV distributions — with FishAI privacy overlay stricter than aggregator defaults.
minimum_quality_threshold: Default withhold. Official polygons only if already public at that grain.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: NEVER_PUBLISH native GPS, depth, moon timing, choruses used to find aggregations

definition: Partner farm/ecosystem operations outcome used as W1 label family ops_disruption_72h: mortality of cultured stock, workability (can crew work the tide/gear), and intervention (early harvest, re-submerge, shade, move). Claim-class: OPERATIONALLY_OBSERVED farm outcome, not wild abundance, not NSSP harvest class. WA DOH closures are EMIV-HUM-HARV-001, not this variable.
unit: event/severity as partner protocol (binary or ordinal); percent dead only if inventoried
biological_relevance: Realized stress and operational disruption of cultured Magallana gigas (W1). Animals are already on the lease.
taxonomic_relevance: Cultured stock on named leases; not a wild census.
spatial_scale: lease / bag-or-bed; PUBLIC grain growing-area or coarser with rule-of-3
preferred_measurement_methods: Partner logs under DUA (mortality, workability, intervention). PSI/WSG rapid-response surveys as corroboration not as public GT.
valid_proxy_methods: None from DOH closures, WAHH volume, or SST. Closures miss heat-kill when harvest stays legally open.
uncertainty_method: Reporting completeness; without logs the EMIV is unidentified (UNKNOWN). No FishAI skill score exists.
update_expectation: daily partner; none in this repo (not ingested)
source_standards: Superset: no GOOS EOV for farm KPIs. Related to GOOS Fish/invertebrate abundance only as cultured-stock operations, not wild EOV. Privacy: farm KPIs PRIVATE/NEVER_PUBLISH publicly.
minimum_quality_threshold: Partner protocol + DUA. Zero public rows in this program as of 2026-09-18.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PRIVATE; public microdata NEVER_PUBLISH; disease-attributed outbreaks NEVER_PUBLISH

definition: Human fishing effort (soak time, trap counts, hours fished, sets). Pressure and catchability confounder. Not abundance of target taxa. Native waypoints NEVER_PUBLISH.
biological_relevance: Mortality pressure; CPUE denominator.
spatial_scale: trip to management unit; public RFMO/stat area
preferred_measurement_methods: Logbooks/VMS under lawful access; observer effort
valid_proxy_methods: AIS is incomplete (EMIV-HUM-AIS-001) and must not be treated as full effort, especially inshore Maine <65 ft
uncertainty_method: Non-reporting; AIS carriage gaps
source_standards: Pressure, not GOOS Fish EOV. Related to fishing-effort indicators in DPSIR frameworks.
minimum_quality_threshold: No public native grain. No GFW ingest (NC).
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: HIGH; native effort NEVER_PUBLISH; VMS confidential; public aggregates only

definition: Transmitted AIS positions/density as a human-pressure / traffic observation. Incomplete by class, garbling, and switch-off. Not fish abundance (see rejected EMIV-BIO-AISN-001). Identity NEVER_PUBLISH in public products. GFW not ingested (NC).
biological_relevance: Effort crowding, noise, strike risk — not biomass.
preferred_measurement_methods: Lawful AIS feeds with privacy stripping; not VMS unless statutory
valid_proxy_methods: None for abundance. Optional later CPUE confounder only with licence/privacy review.
uncertainty_method: Carriage completeness UNKNOWN and often low inshore
source_standards: Not an EOV of fish. Ocean sound / shipping pressure related. IOOS does not treat AIS as a core biological variable.
minimum_quality_threshold: Fail gate if mapped to BIO-ABUND. Do not show MMSI publicly.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: NEVER_PUBLISH identity, highliner routes, reconstructed fishing patterns at native grain

definition: Human-generated sound (shipping, pile driving, sonar as pressure). Distinct from biological detections (those are occurrence). PAM localization of mammals NEVER_PUBLISH.
unit: dB re 1 uPa as metric documented
biological_relevance: Masking, disturbance, injury risk.
taxonomic_relevance: Vocal mammals and fishes; invertebrates poorly known.
preferred_measurement_methods: Calibrated hydrophones; model soundscapes labeled modeled
valid_proxy_methods: AIS traffic as incomplete noise proxy
uncertainty_method: Propagation model error UNKNOWN
source_standards: GOOS EOV Ocean Sound. IOOS core: Ocean sound.
minimum_quality_threshold: No public mammal bearings. Link Slow Zones as published.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: NEVER_PUBLISH localizations/bearings of listed callers; array geometry that enables DIY localization restricted

definition: Human pollution sources and events (spills, outfalls, debris) as pressure. Concentrations belong to EMIV-BGC-POLL-001 when measured.
biological_relevance: Exposure pathway.
preferred_measurement_methods: Official spill/outfall records
valid_proxy_methods: None for legal harvest
uncertainty_method: Reporting completeness UNKNOWN
source_standards: IOOS contaminants related (pressure side). DPSIR pressure.
minimum_quality_threshold: Do not invent loads
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: Official records as published; security-sensitive outfalls not a targeting layer

variable_name: Habitat damage (bottom contact, dredge, blast, anchor)
definition: Physical habitat destruction/degradation from human activities. Not natural disturbance from storms (those are PHY-WAVE).
biological_relevance: Loss of structured habitat.
preferred_measurement_methods: Permitted activity logs; benthic change detection with validation
valid_proxy_methods: AIS of dredge vessels incomplete
uncertainty_method: UNKNOWN intensity if unobserved
source_standards: Pressure on GOOS habitat-forming EOVs.
minimum_quality_threshold: No public unpublished remnant-reef damage maps that enable further harm
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: COARSENED; remnant sites NEVER_PUBLISH

definition: Non-fishing vessel transit (cargo, tanker, ferry) as strike/noise/wake pressure. Distinct from fishing effort. Still not abundance.
biological_relevance: Strike and noise; wake in estuaries.
preferred_measurement_methods: Lawful AIS stripped of identity for analytics; official TSS lanes
valid_proxy_methods: None for biology N
uncertainty_method: AIS gaps
source_standards: Human pressure; related to ocean sound EOV drivers.
minimum_quality_threshold: No competitor tracking; no public MMSI
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: NEVER_PUBLISH identity; official lanes PUBLIC

definition: Presence and intensity of aquaculture as a human use (lease outlines, gear types). Farm performance KPIs are not this pressure layer — they are PRIVATE EMIV-ECO-OPSOUT-001. Public product may show official concession outlines only, no KPIs.
biological_relevance: Use conflict, nutrient loading, disease risk context.
preferred_measurement_methods: Official lease/growing-area records
valid_proxy_methods: Imagery of rafts labeled structures not biomass
uncertainty_method: n/a for official outlines
source_standards: Human use; not GOOS wild Fish EOV.
minimum_quality_threshold: No public KPIs; rule-of-3 so outlooks cannot invert a lease
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: Lease corners/KPIs PRIVATE or NEVER_PUBLISH; growing-area outline may be PUBLIC as official

definition: Construction and industrial marine infrastructure as pressure (wind, oil/gas, cables). Security-sensitive unpublished infrastructure is not an observatory targeting layer.
biological_relevance: Noise, habitat conversion, exclusion.
preferred_measurement_methods: Official project footprints
valid_proxy_methods: None for unpublished cables
uncertainty_method: n/a
source_standards: Human pressure; SMART cables are sensors not this pressure row.
minimum_quality_threshold: No unpublished security-sensitive footprints
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: NEVER_PUBLISH unpublished cables/naval patterns; official wind lease maps as published

definition: Climate-linked stress indices (MHW, heat-dome air extremes, compound low-tide+heat). Pressure/context derived from PHY/BGC, not a separate animal observation. 2021 NE Pacific heat dome is the W1 cautionary event.
unit: index (e.g. MHW category) or event flag
biological_relevance: Anomalous stress beyond climatology.
preferred_measurement_methods: Derived from EMIV-PHY-ATEMP/WTEMP/SST with a published MHW algorithm
valid_proxy_methods: CRW DHW for coral heat stress only
uncertainty_method: Climatology choice; do not fake return periods
source_standards: Derived from GOOS SST EOV + GCOS air T. IPCC/MHW literature. Not an EBV of abundance.
minimum_quality_threshold: Air vs water pathway named (W1 is often air+emersion, not SST MHW)
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC as climate index; fusion with farms PRIVATE

definition: Official MPAs, Slow Zones, SMAs, critical habitat as the authority publishes them. A constraint/pressure overlay (protection reduces some human uses). Link out; do not densify or re-draw. Not a biological observation.
biological_relevance: Masks effort and some encounters; conservation context.
preferred_measurement_methods: Authority GIS as published
valid_proxy_methods: None — do not substitute model habitat
uncertainty_method: n/a (legal geography)
source_standards: Policy geography, not an EOV. WDPA/official NOAA zonation.
minimum_quality_threshold: Exact official geometry; no observatory 'improvement'
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC exactly as published; do not add nest pins inside

definition: Official regulatory constraint: is harvest/fishing legally open in a named management or growing area? Includes WA DOH/NSSP growing-area class and commercial closures, PFMC/CDFW/ODFW salmon open/closed, lobster seasonal rules. Human pressure/constraint, not biodiversity abundance, not farm ops_disruption_72h. FishAI must link the authority and must not impersonate NSSP/WA DOH (WAC 246-282-006).
biological_relevance: Hard mask on lawful encounter/harvest products. Not physiology.
taxonomic_relevance: Managed species/stock as named by the authority.
spatial_scale: official growing-area / PFMC area / statistical area
preferred_measurement_methods: Authority publications (WA DOH, NSSP, council/state in-season notices)
valid_proxy_methods: None for legal status. Rainfall/QPF may flag when conditional rules might trip — still not the legal determination.
required_metadata: authority; area_id; status; effective_time; source_URL; as_of
uncertainty_method: Posting latency; HTML portals fragile. Licence UNKNOWN for redistribution.
update_expectation: as posted; do not scrape in violation of TOS — request export
source_standards: Regulatory, not GOOS EOV / GEO BON EBV. NSSP; WAC 246-282-006; PFMC. https://doh.wa.gov/community-and-environment/shellfish/growing-areas
minimum_quality_threshold: Must display as constraint/authority link. Fail if used as W1 ops label or as abundance.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC as the authority publishes; do not add secret beds

variable_name: Culture method and tidal elevation class
definition: Operator metadata: intertidal vs subtidal, bottom vs bag vs raft/rack, and tidal elevation class. Changes exposure to air heat vs hypoxia. Required W1 metadata (not a public map of bags). Human operational choice, not wild habitat.
biological_relevance: Switches the dominant physical pathway (air×emersion vs water T/DO).
preferred_measurement_methods: Operator-provided under DUA
valid_proxy_methods: Growing-area typical practice only as a weak prior (UNKNOWN at bag scale)
uncertainty_method: UNKNOWN if imputed from region
source_standards: Superset; aquaculture metadata. NOAA Fisheries Pacific oyster culture context.
minimum_quality_threshold: Required for W1 air-heat identification. Not in public maps at bag scale.
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PRIVATE; bag-scale NEVER_PUBLISH

definition: Operational handling/crowding/tending that can kill or stress cultured animals even when ocean physics is moderate (WDFW 2019 die-off note). Only in farm records. Conditional W1 covariate, not public.
biological_relevance: Causal co-factor in some die-offs.
preferred_measurement_methods: Farm ops log
valid_proxy_methods: None
uncertainty_method: Self-report bias UNKNOWN
source_standards: Superset; no EOV. WDFW communication 2019 (tier 3 evidence).
minimum_quality_threshold: Without logs, leave UNKNOWN — do not impute
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PRIVATE/NEVER_PUBLISH

definition: Probability that a taxon or event present in the unit is detected by the applied protocol (p in occupancy models; availability × perception). Without it, absence is UNKNOWN. Acoustic/eDNA/visual each have different p.
unit: probability 0-1 or qualitative high/medium/low if unquantified
biological_relevance: Prevents false absences becoming range holes.
preferred_measurement_methods: Repeat surveys, occupancy models, dual-observer, catchability experiments
valid_proxy_methods: Qualitative expert p only if labeled unquantified
uncertainty_method: Model SE or UNKNOWN — do not fake 0.83
source_standards: MacKenzie occupancy; fisheries catchability literature. Not a GOOS EOV (meta).
minimum_quality_threshold: If p unknown, non-detection ≠ absence
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: Follows parent biological tier

definition: Effort expended to observe (tows, soak hours, drone passes, eDNA filters, observer hours). Required denominator for indices and for interpreting zeros. Distinct from fishing effort pressure (EMIV-HUM-FISH-001) though they can share units.
biological_relevance: Makes zeros interpretable; CPUE cousin.
preferred_measurement_methods: Design logs
valid_proxy_methods: AIS not a survey-effort census
uncertainty_method: Incomplete logs UNKNOWN
source_standards: Survey manuals; not an EOV.
minimum_quality_threshold: Zeros without effort are UNKNOWN
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: Haul GPS follows catch privacy

definition: Fraction and configuration of the decision geography actually observed (stations, swath, H3 cells with data). Unsampled ocean is UNKNOWN, not zero biology. Coverage theater (smooth maps over gaps) is forbidden.
unit: percent area or station density class (low/medium/high)
biological_relevance: Prevents treating interpolation as census.
preferred_measurement_methods: Inventory of contributing observations vs AOI
valid_proxy_methods: None that hide gaps
uncertainty_method: Qualitative density classes until a locked definition exists
source_standards: Observatory coverage maps; GOOS observing-system assessments.
minimum_quality_threshold: Must be publishable alongside any biological claim
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: Coverage maps must not reveal NEVER_PUBLISH sites (show sensor existence not animals)

definition: When observations exist relative to the decision horizon (duty cycle, gaps, night/day, season). A daily L4 SST is not a 6-minute tide.
unit: hours covered / gap length / duty cycle
biological_relevance: Aliases phenology and diel availability.
preferred_measurement_methods: As-of timeline of inputs
valid_proxy_methods: None
uncertainty_method: Gap flags
source_standards: As-of replay design; GHRSST/NRT vs delayed modes.
minimum_quality_threshold: Delayed-mode fields cannot masquerade as issuance-time
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: n/a

definition: Confidence that the AphiaID is correct (expert, photo-voucher, sequence match, acoustic classifier score). Acoustic target classification is not a Linnaean name without validation.
biological_relevance: Wrong names poison occupancy and CPUE.
preferred_measurement_methods: WoRMS match + voucher policy; classifier ROC on independent set
valid_proxy_methods: None from geography-alone ID
uncertainty_method: Confusion matrix if ML; else qualitative
source_standards: WoRMS. ICES acoustic classification caveats.
minimum_quality_threshold: Unvalidated ML species labels cannot support DIRECT_DETECTION occurrence
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: Follows parent

definition: Whether the sensor is in calibration, drift state, and biofouling condition. Unattended coastal sensors foul on week–month scales. Required for DO, salinity, pH, optics, acoustics.
biological_relevance: Bad DO can fake hypoxia events.
preferred_measurement_methods: QARTOD, Winkler/salinity bottle checks, factory cal dates
valid_proxy_methods: None; UNKNOWN if undocumented
uncertainty_method: QARTOD; drift UNKNOWN without checks
source_standards: IOOS QARTOD https://ioos.noaa.gov/project/qartod/
minimum_quality_threshold: Failed QC cannot enter W1_CORE features as truth
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: PUBLIC method; farm sensor locations PRIVATE

definition: Age of each critical input at prediction issuance and whether it would have been available then (no future leakage). Confidence rule input FRESH in FishAI uncertainty policy.
biological_relevance: Stale physics yields false 72 h skill.
preferred_measurement_methods: As-of feature store timestamps
valid_proxy_methods: None
uncertainty_method: Binary leak test on replay
source_standards: FishAI uncertainty policy; GHRSST NRT vs delayed.
minimum_quality_threshold: Any W1 issuance with missing critical env (air T, tide/emersion, or partner label path) is low confidence or not issuable
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: n/a

definition: Confidence in the source identity, licence, and commercial-use class. Visual access ≠ licence. UNKNOWN is valid and blocks paid resale.
biological_relevance: Illegal or NC layers cannot enter paid biology products.
preferred_measurement_methods: Official licence page retrieval (rights agent)
valid_proxy_methods: None — do not infer from 'US Gov looks public'
uncertainty_method: UNKNOWN until official page read for intended use
update_expectation: on source onboarding and periodic re-verify
source_standards: Observatory data_rights_register.md; discovery catalog CONDITIONAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED default.
minimum_quality_threshold: LiveOcean and many IOOS/state portals remain UNKNOWN — cannot be W1 paid layers until reviewed
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: Follows source; NC/GFW not ingested

definition: Native QC flags (QARTOD, GHRSST quality_level, ARGO QC, model QUID usability). Machine-actionable gate before an observation can represent an EMIV.
biological_relevance: Prevents garbage physics driving biological claims.
preferred_measurement_methods: Provider flags unmodified (do not 'improve' generalized points)
valid_proxy_methods: None
uncertainty_method: n/a (gate)
source_standards: QARTOD; GHRSST; Argo QC; Copernicus QUID.
minimum_quality_threshold: Fail flags excluded from W1_CORE truth
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: n/a

definition: Which depth bins are actually observed vs inferred. Surface SST coverage is not bottom-T coverage. W1 v0 bins: INTERTIDAL_AIR and SURFACE_0_5; deeper bins UNKNOWN unless instrumented.
biological_relevance: 3D habitat identification.
preferred_measurement_methods: Inventory of sensors/profiles per bin
valid_proxy_methods: Models labeled inferred not observed
uncertainty_method: Binary coverage
source_standards: Observatory depth_coverage_maps; GOOS subsurface EOV sampling.
minimum_quality_threshold: Must not hide that SST is skin-only
privacy_ecological_sensitivity: n/a
